controller_runtime.accepted_repin: 2026-10-29: accepted pins reconciled to the installed, committed bytes after tools/kit_integrity.py gained accepted-block reconciliation. Three records were stale in a way no earlier verifier could see: accepted.revision described 55541 bytes / ff0008d9, accepted.persistence.pipeline described 44173 bytes / 1470bbef, and accepted.persistence.revision repeated the same stale revision record; installed and committed bytes are 54668 / 1b52b554 and 45341 / 2cd52f93. For each file the SHA-256 of the working copy equals the SHA-256 of HEAD, so the records, not the code, were wrong. accepted.judicial_review's second pin was keyed sha256_review_py, which names no file; the value was correct for judicial_review.py, so only the key changed. No accepted byte was restored and no controller code was edited in this change.
